record.question: Second layer of the earth's atmosphere is called
record.explanation: Answer A: Stratosphere. Counting upward from Earth's surface, the troposphere is first and the stratosphere second, followed by the mesosphere. UCAR's science education source explicitly identifies the stratosphere as the second layer. Historical/source note: Layers counted upward from the surface, using the standard temperature-based atmospheric layers. Reference: https://scied.ucar.edu/learning-zone/atmosphere/stratosphere. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
